overall: The AG found the Board violated the law by listing an absent member as present in the February 18 minutes, but found the minutes otherwise sufficiently detailed. It ordered amended minutes and reminded the Board to take votes by roll call.

allegations.summary: Complaint says the February 18 minutes remain insufficient because they summarize members' opinions without identifying which member spoke.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes do not need to identify each speaker, so long as a member of the public can read the minutes and understand from the summary the nature of the discussion and how the public body arrived at its decisions.

allegations.summary: Approved February 18 minutes list a member as present although she was absent; the draft minutes had recorded her correctly.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to accurately record the members present or absent in the minutes of its February 18 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint appears to say a member left the February 18 meeting but the minutes do not record her departure.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law contains no express requirement that the minutes record a member's departure from a meeting for reasons other than technical difficulties.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the AG noted the final motion to adjourn was not taken by roll call although remote members participated.
allegations.key_passage: Because four members participated remotely during the February 18 meeting, all votes taken during the meeting should have been conducted by roll call.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the February 18 meeting to accurately reflect the members who were present or absent, and certify to the AG within 30 days that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements; similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to amend the minutes of the February 18 meeting to accurately reflect the members who were present or absent and to certify to this office within thirty (30) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
